# R for applied epidemiology and public health {.unnumbered}

**Objective:** Serve as a quick R code reference manual (online and [**offline**](data_used.qmd)) with task-centered examples that address common epidemiological problems.

## How to use this handbook {.unnumbered}

-   Browse the pages in the Table of Contents, or use the search box
-   Click the "copy" icons to copy code\
-   You can follow-along with [the example data](data_used.qmd)

**Offline version**

See instructions in the [Download handbook and data](data_used.qmd) page.
